name: owner-queue
description: One queue, in a side pane of every session, of the commands only you run: sessions add to it instead of writing commands in prose, a guard sends held commands there, Copy puts the command on your clipboard, and the item ticks itself when you run it with !.

pane.title: Pane
pane.description: auto opens the pane when something waits for you; command opens it only with /queue; off never opens it (the one-line band above the prompt stays).

held.title: More held commands
held.description: A regular expression of further commands the model may not run, added to the built-in list (infrastructure applies, AWS writes and deletes, GitHub settings and API writes). Empty adds none.

pushable.title: Pushable repositories
pushable.description: owner/name of the repositories, separated by spaces, whose default branch the sessions may push to: a plain push of the current branch or of main/master to origin passes when the folder's origin is one of them. Force pushes, --all, --mirror and other remotes stay held. Empty holds every push to main/master.

dir.title: Queue folder
dir.description: Where the queue lives, shared by every session on this machine. Empty is ~/.local/state/owner-queue.
